title: Christmas in the village is officially open
preheader: 10 Nov to 20 Dec · 1, 2 or 3 courses · prosecco on 2 and 3 · four festive nights · booking open now.

image.alt: A Christmas dinner at The Anchor: roast beef, a Yorkshire pudding, pigs in blankets, stuffing, roast potatoes, mash, peas and sprouts

data.placeholder_caption: Christmas table laid up, warm low light
data.headline: Christmas in the village is officially open
body: Christmas dinner is on from 10 November to 20 December, for groups of six or more. Everyone picks their own courses, and we will do the rest.

data.footnote: A glass of prosecco is included on the 2 and 3 course menus, swappable for orange juice. Christmas dinner comes with pigs in blankets, stuffing, Yorkshire pudding, roast potatoes, mash, peas and sprouts. £10 per person deposit, taken straight off your bill.

data.heading: Not decided yet? That is fine
body: Have a look at what is on the menu, or tell us the date you are thinking of and we will let you know what we have got. No commitment either way.

data.heading: Four festive nights before Christmas
data.body: Booking is open on all four, and every one is a good excuse to round people up.

events.title: Tasting Night
events.detail: A premium tasting night with dinner provided, 7pm. The theme is still a surprise.

events.title: Tinsel & Trivia Quiz Night
events.detail: £3 cash entry, 7pm. Festive rounds and proper prizes.

events.title: Sleigh My Name: Festive Music Bingo
events.detail: £5, 7pm. Two themed rounds with Nikki hosting.

events.title: Christmas Jackpot Cash Bingo
events.detail: £10 cash books, 10 games, 7pm, with a rollover Snowball.

data.body: We would love this to be the best Christmas the village has had in years, and it is the people who walk through the door who make it one.

data.heading: Know who books your work Christmas do?
data.body: We would love the chance to look after your team, so please do pass us on.
Book your table, ask about a date, or just pop in and tell us what you are planning.

data.ps_body: If your workplace has not sorted its Christmas do yet, send whoever is organising it our way.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, and we would love to see you again this Christmas.
